+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_CHAT_COMPLETIONS_URL = "https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions"
+OPENAI_MODEL = "gpt-4o-mini"
+
+
+def _messages_from_prompt(prompt: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]:
+    return [{"role": "user", "content": prompt}]
+
+
+def collect_platform_metadata(prompt: str, model: str = OPENAI_MODEL) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    api_key = os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise RuntimeError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        OPENAI_CHAT_COMPLETIONS_URL,
+        headers={
+            "Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}",
+            "Content-Type": "application/json",
+        },
+        json={
+            "model": model,
+            "messages": _messages_from_prompt(prompt),
+        },
+        timeout=60,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    payload = response.json()
+
+    choice = payload["choices"][0]
+    message = choice.get("message", {})
+
+    return {
+        "provider": "openai",
+        "model": payload.get("model", model),
+        "resource_id": payload.get("id"),
+        "output": message.get("content"),
+        "usage": payload.get("usage"),
+        "finish_reason": choice.get("finish_reason"),
+        "model_handle": model,
+        "raw": payload,
+    }
+
+
+def main() -> None:
+    prompt = os.environ.get("PROMPT", "Hello")
+    result = collect_platform_metadata(prompt)
+    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()
*** End Patch

+import os
+from typing import Iterable, Iterator, List, Optional
+
+from openai import OpenAI
+
+
+def _chunk_text_from_event(event) -> str:
+    delta = getattr(event, "delta", None)
+    if delta is None:
+        return ""
+    content = getattr(delta, "content", None)
+    if content is None:
+        return ""
+    if isinstance(content, list):
+        parts: List[str] = []
+        for item in content:
+            text = getattr(item, "text", None)
+            if text is not None:
+                parts.append(text)
+        return "".join(parts)
+    if isinstance(content, str):
+        return content
+    return ""
+
+
+def stream_platform_generation(
+    prompt: str,
+    model: str = "gpt-4o-mini",
+    system: Optional[str] = None,
+) -> Iterator[object]:
+    client = OpenAI(api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
+    messages = []
+    if system:
+        messages.append({"role": "system", "content": system})
+    messages.append({"role": "user", "content": prompt})
+    with client.responses.stream(model=model, input=messages) as stream:
+        for event in stream:
+            text = _chunk_text_from_event(event)
+            if text:
+                yield text
+            yield event
+
+
+def collect_stream(prompt: str, model: str = "gpt-4o-mini", system: Optional[str] = None) -> List[object]:
+    return list(stream_platform_generation(prompt=prompt, model=model, system=system))
*** End Patch

*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: select_platform_resource.py
+import os
+import requests
+
+
+OPENAI_MODELS_ENDPOINT = "https://api.openai.com/v1/models"
+
+
+def select_platform_resource(resource_name: str) -> str:
+    api_key = os.getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")
+    if not api_key:
+        raise EnvironmentError("OPENAI_API_KEY is required")
+
+    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {api_key}"}
+    response = requests.get(OPENAI_MODELS_ENDPOINT, headers=headers, timeout=30)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    data = response.json()
+    models = data.get("data", [])
+
+    if not resource_name:
+        raise ValueError("resource_name is required")
+
+    normalized = resource_name.strip()
+    if not normalized:
+        raise ValueError("resource_name is required")
+
+    available = {item.get("id") for item in models if isinstance(item, dict)}
+    if normalized in available:
+        return normalized
+
+    aliases = {
+        "gpt-5.4-mini": "openai/gpt-5.4-mini",
+        "gpt-4.1": "gpt-4.1",
+        "gpt-4o": "gpt-4o",
+    }
+    resolved = aliases.get(normalized, normalized)
+    if resolved in available:
+        return resolved
+
+    raise LookupError(f"OpenAI resource not available: {resource_name}")
*** End Patch
